_comment: Keys starting with _ are ignored by the app (hints only).
_openapi_video: SRGSSR Video OpenAPI 3: server https://api.srgssr.ch/videometadata/v2 — GET /latest_episodes?bu=&pageSize= — GET /episodes_by_date/{day}?bu=&pageSize= (day = YYYY-MM-DD).
_openapi_oauth: Video OpenAPI security tokenUrl: https://srgssr-prod.apigee.net/oauth/v1/accesstoken?grant_type=client_credentials — default oauth_token_url uses this host; code also tries api.srgssr.ch.
_openapi_subtitles: Play Subtitles v2: server https://api.srgssr.ch/srgssr-play-subtitles/v2 — GET /subtitles?episode=<URN> (query param name is episode). Response: JSON array of {id, url}.
_subtitle_filters_hint: subtitle_filters: allow_show_ids, allow_channel_ids (string[]), title_must_match_regex, title_must_not_match_regex (PCRE on title+description+show_title+channel_title). Both allowlists set => show OR channel match. {} or omit = all items. Skipped rows stored with empty subtitles so they are not retried. Tune regex for news (e.g. Tagesschau, Schweiz aktuell) and exclude sports (Fussball, Bundesliga).
